verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes its own Data Access API, an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec with a developer-portal reference and pagination docs. It lets you retrieve your errors, projects and organization data, which is a documented, machine-readable way to get data out. The webhook data-forwarding plugin also exposes error and project data as it arrives. However, nothing documents a dedicated bulk export or account-exit flow, or confirms that every data type can be extracted in an open format. Missing for 10: a documented one-shot full-account export, explicit open-format guarantees (e.g. JSON/CSV dumps), coverage of all data types (events, sessions, performance spans), and hands-on corroboration of migrating off.
